label: Contingent support of a necessary concretum at some admitted world
term: contingent support of a necessary concretum
definition: SomeNecessaryConcretumContingentlySupported m w holds when there are a world v and concrete candidates a and b such that a exists at v, b exists at every world accessible from w, a stands to b in the selected relation at v, and a is absent from some world accessible from w. Ordinary meaning: somewhere in the space of worlds, a thing that could not have failed to exist is sustained by a thing that could have. Example: a necessary whole whose sustaining parts differ from world to world. It does not say the necessary thing is supported at w itself or at every world.
note: Analyst framework definition of a rival position; attribution deferred. Motivated by bottom-up grounding of a necessary whole in replaceable constituents. Rival of NoContingentConcreteSupport on the same Profile and selected world. It implies the negation constructively and exhibits the world from which the supporter is absent; with excluded middle it is equivalent to the negation. As in the premise, v ranges over all admitted worlds, not only accessible ones.
